runs/base_sft/best.pt.story:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play outside in the garden. One day, she saw a butterfly flying around. She wanted to catch it, but it flew away. 

Lily was sad because she really wanted to catch the butterfly. She went to her mom and told her about the butterfly. Her mom said, "Don't worry, Lily. Let's watch the butterfly together." 

Lily and her mom sat down and watched the butterfly fly around the garden. They saw the butterfly land on a flower and then fly away. Lily was happy again because she got to see the butterfly and see it fly away.
